objective: For explicit checked aggregate uses over F2, replace the XOR of pair names by its direct quadratic polynomial, deriving the required boundary equations and showing the exact limits on the displayed proof rules.
status: Proved: A supplied degree-two proof may carry a correctly derived pair XOR directly as an ordinary quadratic while keeping the final AND on a crossed chain. The Boolean choice has an O(m) derivation. The actual rule inscriptions and boundary derivations determine whether direct replay is admissible.
title: Carry the XOR of pair products as an ordinary quadratic
